english.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for wealth in general, especially when discussing society, nations, or abstract riches.
This is the all-purpose noun for wealth or riches.
Use this noun when abundance means wealth or accumulated assets rather than a quantity of things.
Use this formal term for wealth as an abstract possession or accumulated assets.

examples.english: A society's wealth shouldn't be concentrated in the hands of just a few people.
examples.traditional: 一個社會嘅財富，唔應該只係集中喺少數人手上。
